name: agenthropic
description: Self-hosted, local-first dashboard for observing Claude Code agent and subagent activity - persisted subagent DAG and dollar-accurate cost attribution, read from the JSONL transcripts.
author: Ivan Baev
//: `start` is the single-port run: build the SPA, then start the server, which serves the built SPA and /api from the SAME loopback origin (http://127.0.0.1:4317 by default; DASHBOARD_PORT overrides the port, the host never). It is a plain script composition on purpose. Do NOT add a build step for apps/server - `pnpm --filter @agenthropic/server start` must keep running from TypeScript source under tsx; the reason is spelled out in apps/server/package.json and it is a real landmine (migration checksums).
